description: Create all Solidity contracts (LandTitleNFT, LandRegistry, ValidatorRegistry), Hardhat scripts (deploy.ts, generate-test-accounts.ts), and 24 contract tests (9 + 10 + 5). Run npm install in packages/contracts first. All 24 tests must pass on the Hardhat built-in network. This feature depends on FEAT-001 only for genesis context — it does not share code with it. It is independent of FEAT-003.
steps: Run 'npm install' in C:\Users\StarLab\Desktop\Library\Anagu\packages\contracts to install hardhat, @openzeppelin/contracts v5, @nomicfoundation/hardhat-toolbox, ethers, typechain, ts-node, typescript

Create C:\Users\StarLab\Desktop\Library\Anagu\packages\contracts\contracts\LandTitleNFT.sol — Solidity 0.8.24, inherits ERC721URIStorage + AccessControl + ReentrancyGuard from OZ v5. REGISTRY_ROLE = keccak256('REGISTRY_ROLE'), GOVERNOR_ROLE = keccak256('GOVERNOR_ROLE'). TitleMetadata struct: (string parcelReference, string spatialHash, string ownerReference, string documentHash, uint256 issuedAt, bool isRevoked, uint256 revokedAt, string revocationGrounds, address revokedBy). mapping(uint256 => TitleMetadata) public titleMetadata, mapping(uint256 => bool) public isRevoked. _update() override: first check isRevoked[tokenId] and revert 'LandTitleNFT: title is revoked' if true; then if auth != address(0) and !hasRole(REGISTRY_ROLE, msg.sender) revert 'LandTitleNFT: direct transfer not allowed'. mint(address to, uint256 tokenId, string memory uri) onlyRole(REGISTRY_ROLE): _mint, _setTokenURI, populate titleMetadata.issuedAt=block.timestamp, emit TitleIssued(tokenId, to). burn(uint256 tokenId) onlyRole(REGISTRY_ROLE): _burn. revoke(uint256 tokenId, string memory grounds) onlyRole(GOVERNOR_ROLE): require !isRevoked[tokenId], set flags, emit TitleRevoked(tokenId, msg.sender, grounds). getTitleMetadata(uint256) returns (TitleMetadata memory). Constructor(address admin): grant DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, REGISTRY_ROLE, GOVERNOR_ROLE to admin. Events: TitleIssued(uint256 indexed tokenId, address indexed to), TitleRevoked(uint256 indexed tokenId, address indexed by, string grounds).

Create C:\Users\StarLab\Desktop\Library\Anagu\packages\contracts\contracts\LandRegistry.sol — Solidity 0.8.24, imports LandTitleNFT, inherits AccessControl + ReentrancyGuard. REGISTRAR_ROLE = keccak256('REGISTRAR_ROLE'), GOVERNOR_ROLE = keccak256('GOVERNOR_ROLE'). RecordStatus enum {Active, Transferred, Revoked, Cancelled}. LandRecord struct: (uint256 tokenId, string parcelReference, address currentOwner, string spatialHash, string ownerReference, string documentHash, uint256 registeredAt, uint256 lastUpdatedAt, RecordStatus status). mapping(string => LandRecord) public records, mapping(string => address[]) public ownershipHistory, uint256 private _tokenIdCounter = 1, LandTitleNFT public landTitleNFT. registerLand(address owner, string parcelRef, string spatialHash, string ownerRef, string docHash, string uri) onlyRole(REGISTRAR_ROLE) nonReentrant: require records[parcelRef].registeredAt == 0, mint via landTitleNFT.mint(owner, _tokenIdCounter, uri), save LandRecord, push owner to ownershipHistory, emit LandRegistered, increment _tokenIdCounter. transferOwnership(string parcelRef, address newOwner) onlyRole(REGISTRAR_ROLE) nonReentrant: require records[parcelRef].status == RecordStatus.Active, call landTitleNFT.safeTransferFrom(currentOwner, newOwner, tokenId), update record, push newOwner to history, emit OwnershipTransferred. revokeTitle(string parcelRef, string grounds) onlyRole(GOVERNOR_ROLE) nonReentrant: require record exists and Active, call landTitleNFT.revoke(tokenId, grounds), set status=Revoked, emit LandRevoked. getRecord(string) returns LandRecord memory. getOwnershipHistory(string) returns address[] memory. Constructor(address admin, address _landTitleNFT): grant DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, REGISTRAR_ROLE, GOVERNOR_ROLE to admin, set landTitleNFT. Events: LandRegistered(string indexed parcelReference, uint256 indexed tokenId, address indexed owner), OwnershipTransferred(string indexed parcelReference, uint256 indexed tokenId, address indexed from, address to), LandRevoked(string indexed parcelReference, uint256 indexed tokenId, string grounds).

Create C:\Users\StarLab\Desktop\Library\Anagu\packages\contracts\contracts\ValidatorRegistry.sol — Solidity 0.8.24, inherits AccessControl. ADMIN_ROLE = keccak256('ADMIN_ROLE'). NatSpec @dev on contract: 'Advisory registry only. QBFT consensus is not modified by this contract.' mapping(address => uint256) public validatorWeight, mapping(address => bool) public isValidator, address[] private _validators. addValidator(address, uint256) onlyRole(ADMIN_ROLE): require !isValidator, set state, push to array, emit ValidatorAdded. removeValidator(address) onlyRole(ADMIN_ROLE): require isValidator, clear state, swap-and-pop from array, emit ValidatorRemoved. updateWeight(address, uint256) onlyRole(ADMIN_ROLE): require isValidator, update weight, emit ValidatorWeightUpdated. getValidators() returns address[] memory. getTotalWeight() returns uint256. Constructor(address admin): grant DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and ADMIN_ROLE to admin. Events: ValidatorAdded(address indexed, uint256), ValidatorRemoved(address indexed), ValidatorWeightUpdated(address indexed, uint256).
Run 'npx hardhat compile' from C:\Users\StarLab\Desktop\Library\Anagu\packages\contracts to verify all 3 contracts compile and typechain-types are generated

Create C:\Users\StarLab\Desktop\Library\Anagu\packages\contracts\scripts\deploy.ts — imports hre from hardhat, ethers from hardhat. Steps: (1) get deployer signer, (2) deploy LandTitleNFT(deployer.address), (3) deploy LandRegistry(deployer.address, landTitleNFT.target), (4) grant REGISTRY_ROLE on landTitleNFT to landRegistry.target, (5) deploy ValidatorRegistry(deployer.address), (6) mkdir packages/contracts/deployments if not exists, (7) write addresses.json with network, chainId, contract addresses, deployedAt timestamp. Use 'import { ethers, network } from hardhat' and 'import * as fs from node:fs'.

Create C:\Users\StarLab\Desktop\Library\Anagu\packages\contracts\test\LandTitleNFT.test.ts with 9 tests using loadFixture from @nomicfoundation/hardhat-network-helpers and expect from chai. Fixture deploys LandTitleNFT(admin.address), grants REGISTRY_ROLE to separate registrar signer, grants GOVERNOR_ROLE to separate governor signer. Tests: (1) deploy with correct roles — verify admin/registrar/governor role assignments, (2) mint with metadata — mint token 1, check ownerOf and titleMetadata.issuedAt, (3) emit TitleIssued event, (4) prevent direct user transfer — user1 transferFrom reverts with 'LandTitleNFT: direct transfer not allowed', (5) GOVERNOR revokes title — sets isRevoked[1]=true, (6) prevent double revocation — second revoke reverts, (7) prevent non-GOVERNOR revocation — user1 revoke reverts with AccessControl error, (8) prevent transfer of revoked title — mint, revoke, then registrar transferFrom reverts with 'LandTitleNFT: title is revoked', (9) store and retrieve full metadata — mint, call getTitleMetadata(1), assert all fields.

Create C:\Users\StarLab\Desktop\Library\Anagu\packages\contracts\test\LandRegistry.test.ts with 10 tests. Fixture deploys LandTitleNFT + LandRegistry, grants REGISTRY_ROLE on NFT to LandRegistry.target, grants REGISTRAR_ROLE and GOVERNOR_ROLE on LandRegistry to separate signers. Tests: (1) register parcel and mint NFT — record.tokenId==1, nft.ownerOf(1)==user1, (2) emit LandRegistered event, (3) prevent duplicate registration — second registerLand for same parcelRef reverts, (4) REGISTRAR transfers ownership — record.currentOwner updated, nft.ownerOf updated, (5) prevent direct NFT transfer bypassing registry — user1 nft.transferFrom reverts, (6) GOVERNOR revokes through registry — record.status==Revoked, nft.isRevoked(1)==true, (7) prevent non-GOVERNOR revocation — user1 revokeTitle reverts, (8) prevent transfer of revoked parcel — after revoke, registrar transferOwnership reverts, (9) full ownership history 3 entries — register + 2 transfers = history length 3, (10) gas for registerLand < 500000 — receipt.gasUsed < 500000n.
